name: Skill name registration
does: Registers the skill as `next`, invoked by the user as /mise:next.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: parsed by the harness at load

name: Skill trigger description
does: Declares when to run: bug report, what to work on next, start/continue a feature.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: description text is in every session's skill index

name: Argument hint
does: Shows `[setup | what to work on]` as the argument hint in the UI.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: UI affordance only

name: Model invocation disabled
does: Blocks autonomous model invocation; only an explicit user command starts the workflow.
preventsClaim: the model starting a whole workflow run unbidden (implied)
costNote: harness-enforced flag

name: Pre-approved tool allowlist
does: Pre-approves state.ts plus git add/commit/mv/branch/switch and mkdir.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: permission prompts mid-run)
costNote: harness permission check

name: Frontmatter close and title
does: Closes frontmatter and titles the document.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Driver is a dispatcher
does: Driver reads state, routes to an instruction file, and does no stage work itself.
preventsClaim: the driver doing stage work outside the dispatched stage's instructions

name: Copy the progress checklist
does: Copy a four-step checklist into the reply and tick each step.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: skipping a dispatch step)
costNote: 9 lines emitted into the transcript every run

name: Modes heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Empty arguments runs checklist
does: Empty $ARGUMENTS runs the whole checklist end to end.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: setup argument forces setup
does: `setup` dispatches setup even with a filled config, then stops.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Question mark prints usage
does: `?` prints the usage line and stops.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: terminal stop; user must re-invoke

name: Free text is description
does: Any other argument is a work description carried into the start gate.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Load context heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Load interaction.md and config
does: Read references/interaction.md and .claude/mise-config.md before doing anything else.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: stages assuming unloaded conventions)
costNote: 2 file reads every run; interaction.md is 100 lines

name: Ground rules lead-in
does: Lead-in to the ground rules list.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Dispatch means read and follow
does: Defines dispatch: read the stage file and follow it; it assumes the two loaded files.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Relative paths resolve to skill
does: Relative paths in dispatched files resolve against the skill directory, never the project.
preventsClaim: resolving skill-relative paths against the project tree

name: State access only via engine
does: Every .workflow-state read or write goes through the state engine; never inspect or edit by hand.
preventsClaim: hand-edited or hand-interpreted state files

name: Commit mise directory at checkpoints
does: Commit the mise directory at every checkpoint with a bare `mise:` subject prefix.
preventsClaim: a checkout of the branch not being able to resume the work
costNote: 1 git commit per checkpoint: creation, each approval, each task done, cleanup

name: Config gate resumes after setup
does: A blocked config value dispatches setup, then resumes where the gate fired.
preventsClaim: running a stage without the config values it needs

name: Missing config blocks everything
does: No config file or no Mise directory value dispatches setup, then resumes with the original arguments.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: no working directory to write to)
costNote: drops into the full setup interview

name: Quality commands gate execute
does: Missing Format/Check/Unit tests or a missing Checklist file blocks the execute dispatch, re-firing at execute and acceptance.
preventsClaim: executing tasks with no way to verify them
costNote: fires up to twice per run (stage:execute, acceptance)

name: Branch convention gates new work
does: A missing Branch convention blocks starting new work only.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: an off-convention branch name)

name: Nothing else blocks
does: No other missing config value blocks the run.
preventsClaim: the config gate firing for optional sections

name: State engine heading and framing
does: Heading and the claim that .workflow-state drives every routing decision.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Run report --write
does: Run `node scripts/state.ts report <mise-directory> --write` to get next_action.
preventsClaim: routing decisions made from prose instead of state
costNote: 1 node run per dispatch; re-run after each self-approving stage (up to ~5 per run)

name: Node 24 or stop
does: A missing or older node is reported and the run stops.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: the engine cannot run TypeScript directly)
costNote: terminal stop

name: One run initializes and computes
does: One engine run initializes the state file on a fresh start and computes next_action.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Re-run engine only on change
does: Re-run the engine only after mise-directory content changes or a stage records an approval.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: redundant engine runs)

name: Surface reopened stages
does: A `reopened` list means a doc changed after approval; surface which stages and why before acting.
preventsClaim: silently redoing stages the user thought were approved

name: Relay engine error and stop
does: A broken or hand-edited state file yields an error naming the user's options: relay it and stop.
preventsClaim: the workflow repairing state by inference
costNote: terminal stop; user restores from git or deletes the directory

name: Continue or start heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: One piece of work per branch
does: A mise directory with any content means work is in flight; one piece at a time per branch.
preventsClaim: two pieces of work sharing one branch and one state file

name: In-flight gate
does: Branch on the report's in_flight field before doing anything else.
preventsClaim: starting new work on top of in-flight work

name: In flight, no description continues
does: in_flight true with no description continues that work.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: In flight plus description refuses
does: in_flight true with any description stops with a fixed message telling the user to use a fresh branch.
preventsClaim: a second piece of work starting while one is in flight
costNote: terminal stop; user must switch branch and re-invoke

name: Backlog prompt
does: No work and no description: list the config's backlog items numbered, or ask what to work on.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: nothing to start from)
costNote: 1 external backlog fetch when a ## Backlog section exists; 1 user turn

name: Classify bug or feature
does: Classify the description as a defect (bugfix route) or new behavior (feature) from keyword cues.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: running the wrong route)

name: Ambiguous classification asks user
does: Ambiguous work asks "Bug fix or new feature?"; never guess silently.
preventsClaim: silently guessing the route
costNote: 1 user turn

name: Ensure a work branch
does: Decide the work branch from `git branch --show-current` before starting.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: work landing on the default branch)
costNote: 1 git call

name: Create branch from convention
does: On main/master, derive a name from the Branch convention and the classification and `git switch -c`.
preventsClaim: committing the work onto the default branch
costNote: 1 git switch

name: Reuse empty conforming branch
does: Reuse a non-default branch with no commits past the default and a conforming name, without asking.
preventsClaim: asking a question whose answer is already unambiguous
costNote: 1 `git log main..HEAD`

name: Otherwise ask about branch
does: Any other branch asks whether to use it or create a new one from it.
preventsClaim: work landing on a branch the user did not intend
costNote: 1 user turn

name: Start work and commit
does: Create the mise directory, write the description verbatim to goals.md, commit, carry the classification forward.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: losing the user's own words)
costNote: 1 mkdir + 1 commit

name: Missing goals file asks
does: Continuing with goals.md missing asks "What's the goal for this work?" and writes the answer verbatim.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a goals stage with no input)
costNote: 1 user turn

name: Act on next_action heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Announce the stage
does: Print `Running stage: <stage>` before dispatching the stage's file.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: the user not seeing where the run is)
costNote: 1 line per stage dispatch

name: next_action to file table
does: Maps each next_action value to the stage file to read and follow.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: dispatching the wrong instructions)
costNote: the dispatched stage file is 43-159 lines of added context

name: Artifact existence is not approval
does: A stage's artifact existing never counts as that stage being approved.
preventsClaim: skipping a stage because its file happens to exist

name: Offer backlog prompt after acceptance
does: When execute returns from acceptance, offer the backlog prompt again.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 extra user turn at the end of every run

name: Stopping rules heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Stop only at three points
does: Once a stage is dispatched, stop only at the goals gate, the acceptance pass, or a real blocker.
preventsClaim: the run halting to ask the user things it can resolve

name: Resolve unambiguous next steps
does: When the next step is unambiguous, resolve and run it rather than asking to confirm.
preventsClaim: confirmation questions that add no information

name: Loop after self-approving stages
does: After a stage self-approves at its critic gate, re-run report --write and dispatch the next stage in-session.
preventsClaim: ending the turn and making the user re-run /mise:next between stages
costNote: exit: next_action is a human gate, execute stop, or close_out; up to ~4 iterations (goals, requirements, plan, execute)

name: Do not list heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: No advancing past goals gate
does: Never advance past the goals(+mock) gate without the user's explicit approval.
preventsClaim: building on goals the user never approved

name: No advancing without critic pass
does: Never advance past a critic gate without a critic pass.
preventsClaim: an unreviewed requirements doc or plan reaching execution

name: Never re-ask recorded decisions
does: Never re-ask decisions already recorded in .workflow-state.
preventsClaim: asking the user the same question twice across sessions

name: Never stop between stages
does: Never stop between self-approving stages.
preventsClaim: a run that needs several user invocations to reach execute

name: Never touch state file directly
does: Touch .workflow-state only through state.ts; next's only state write is report --write.
preventsClaim: the driver corrupting state it cannot validate

name: Never delete directory unconfirmed
does: Delete the mise directory only after the user confirms the work finished or abandoned.
preventsClaim: destroying in-flight work and its state
